name: tell-tail
description: Tell-Tail local observability, with AI Activity for ChatGPT and Codex and a first-class Logs workspace.

interface.shortDescription: AI Activity for ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: Open Tell-Tail AI Activity for supported desktop events, connections, MCP diagnostics and plugin results. Switch to Logs for aggregate desktop log metrics. Persistent tool capture requires setup and a one-time Codex restart. Metadata only; bounded in-memory history.
defaultPrompt: Set up Tell-Tail for ChatGPT and Codex.
Check Tell-Tail capture health and open Activity.
